item.description:

item.title: SWRPG | Partisans of Parsh Episode 1 – Mind the Uptake
item.description:
Meet Pal, Soli, Salculdia, and Nulus, the last remnants of Aegis Squadron. After a vicious ambush, the last remaining U-Wing arrives on the planet of Parsh. The local Rebellion contingent is in desperate need of significant reinforcement and our crew may not be enough. See this game live on TWITCH or YOUTUBE!
